_readme: Quantity sold on Etsy per listing ID (listings in products.json only), used for the "sold" lines on the shop pages. Made by scripts/import_etsy_items.py from Etsy Order Items CSVs kept in private/etsy-items/ (git-ignored). No names, addresses, order IDs or money. lastSale is the last sale date counted: to update, download only newer Order Items CSVs and run the importer with --add.
